provenance.method: Current synthetic direct=True Matthiessen outputs; explicit capture
provenance.claim: Compatibility only; independent formula/pure-limit checks run separately

tolerance_reason: abs(actual-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference). rtol=1e-9 is 50 times the 2e-11 quadrature relative target and above observed 1e-14 formula/integral discrepancies, while detecting 1e-6 relative drift. S floor 1e-13 V/K and RH floor 1e-18 m^3/C handle exact compensation; rho floor 1e-15 ohm*m and L floor 1e-17 W*ohm/K^2 bound near-zero noise. These are compatibility budgets, not measurement or model uncertainty.
